vngActor.title: VNG Actor Bridge
vngActor.summary: Maps a VNG Klantinteracties actor UUID to a Nextcloud userId so actor references resolve to an assignee.
vngActor.description: The VNG Klantinteracties API (OpenKlant 2.x) identifies the party that handled or is assigned a klantcontact/internetaak via an `actor` UUID with an `actorType` (medewerker/geautomatiseerdeActor/organisatorischeEenheid). Pipelinq assigns work to a Nextcloud userId (`ticket.assignee` / `task.assigneeUserId`). This schema is the declarative bridge row between the two identity spaces; resolution is a single OpenRegister object read keyed on `actorUuid`, no service class. Config only (vng-klantinteracties-leaf D1/D4).

actorUuid.description: VNG actor UUID as referenced by the OpenConnector Klantinteracties endpoints.
actorUuid.title: Actor UUID

actorType.description: VNG actor kind: medewerker (employee), geautomatiseerdeActor (automated/system actor) or organisatorischeEenheid (organisational unit).
actorType.title: Actor Type

nextcloudUserId.description: Nextcloud userId this actor resolves to; written onto ticket.assignee / task.assigneeUserId.
nextcloudUserId.title: Nextcloud User ID

naam.description: Human-readable display name of the actor.
naam.title: Naam

actief.description: Whether this actor bridge row is currently active and resolvable.
actief.title: Actief

vngKlantinteractieBinding.title: VNG Klantinteracties Binding
vngKlantinteractieBinding.summary: Wires the pipelinq VNG leaf to the OpenConnector vng-klantinteracties-adapter Endpoint/Mapping/Rule slugs.
vngKlantinteractieBinding.description: Declarative binding config referencing the OpenConnector `vng-klantinteracties-adapter` change's frozen Endpoint and Rule slugs verbatim (as-built; see vng-klantinteracties-leaf design.md and its 'Slug corrections' note for the drift versus this leaf's original design assumptions). One Endpoint object per HTTP method exists on the adapter side (its `endpoint.method` property is single-valued, not a comma-list), so list/create/update/patch are separate slug fields here. No pipelinq PHP reads this schema directly today; it documents and freezes the cross-repo wiring for the gateway and for future pipelinq-side tooling.
